offering_description.value: Supplies lithium-ion battery products and energy storage systems to industrial customers, including businesses in transportation and heavy equipment. It develops battery chemistry in-house, customizes designs for customer applications, and manufactures the products.

quotes.quote: Microvast is vertically integrated, with end-to-end oversight spanning research and development through the manufacturing of our battery packs and energy storage systems (ESS), including core battery chemistry (cathode, anode, and electrolyte), with established manufacturing operations worldwide.
Our battery solutions for transportation and heavy equipment feature high energy density, superior safety, long life, and ultra-fast charging capabilities.

primary_products.value: lithium-ion battery packs; energy storage systems; battery cells; battery modules
